headline_marked: Argentina beats Brazil 5-3 in [[Jamuna TV staff friendly match]]
headline: Argentina beats Brazil 5-3 in Jamuna TV staff friendly match
summary: Employees of Jamuna TV organized a spirited football match inspired by World Cup fever, with the Argentina-themed team emerging victorious.
details: Jamuna TV employees organized a friendly football match in Dhaka, dividing themselves into two teams representing Argentina and Brazil.
The match took place on Saturday, June 27, at the turf of Jamuna Future Park, amid a festive atmosphere inspired by the World Cup.
The Argentina-themed team won the match with a score of 5-3. Latif stood out for the winning side, scoring a hat-trick.
Other goals for the winning team were scored by Piyal and Yamin, contributing to the final victory.
The trophy was presented by Jamuna Group Director Kamrul Islam and Jamuna TV CEO Fahim Ahmed, with Head of News Touhidul Islam also in attendance.
The event aimed to strengthen camaraderie, harmony, and mutual bonds among colleagues through sports and friendly competition.
caption:
World Cup fever hits the newsroom! Argentina takes the win in a Jamuna TV staff friendly.

Jamuna TV employees organized a friendly football match in Dhaka, dividing themselves into two teams representing Argentina and Brazil.

The match took place on Saturday, June 27, at the turf of Jamuna Future Park, amid a festive atmosphere inspired by the World Cup.

The Argentina-themed team won the match with a score of 5-3. Latif stood out for the winning side, scoring a hat-trick.

Other goals for the winning team were scored by Piyal and Yamin, contributing to the final victory.

The trophy was presented by Jamuna Group Director Kamrul Islam and Jamuna TV CEO Fahim Ahmed, with Head of News Touhidul Islam also in attendance.

The event aimed to strengthen camaraderie, harmony, and mutual bonds among colleagues through sports and friendly competition.

#JamunaTV #Football #FriendlyMatch #WorldCupFever #Dhaka #SportsSpirit

Source: Jamuna TV

headline_marked: 6 [[student league leaders shot]] in Noakhali after smoking dispute
headline: 6 student league leaders shot in Noakhali after smoking dispute
summary: At least six Chhatra Dal members were shot following a conflict that began when they asked a group of teenagers to stop smoking in public.
details: At least six members of Chhatra Dal were shot in the Sonaimuri upazila of Noakhali on Friday night. The attack occurred at the Nogao Chowrasta area of Sonapur union around 8:30 PM.
caption:
A dispute over public smoking ended in gunfire, leaving six Chhatra Dal members shot in Noakhali.

At least six members of Chhatra Dal were shot in the Sonaimuri upazila of Noakhali on Friday night. The attack occurred at the Nogao Chowrasta area of Sonapur union around 8:30 PM.

#Noakhali #CrimeNews #Bangladesh #Violence #BreakingNews

Source: Prothom Alo
tweet: A dispute over public smoking ended in gunfire, leaving six Chhatra Dal members shot in Noakhali. 12 people have been named as suspects in a case filed by police. #Noakhali #CrimeNews #Bangladesh
